pose_semantics.units: m, kg, s, rad, N, N m
pose_semantics.transform: p_model = R_model_CAD @ p_CAD_m; all link axes are aligned at neutral
pose_semantics.base_link: torso; CAD origin [0,0,300] mm; model x=-CAD Y, y=CAD X, z=CAD Z
pose_semantics.source_side_warning: CAD calls positive X R and negative X L while toe/camera forward is -Y. A reflection would violate right-handed physics. Retain R/L as source identifiers, not REP anatomical side assertions. Neutral R links therefore lie at positive model y.
pose_semantics.optical: z forward, x image right, y image down; physical pixel roll uncalibrated
pose_semantics.quaternion: MuJoCo wxyz; ROS xyzw adapters explicitly convert
pose_semantics.pose_equation: p_W = T_W_C(t_capture) @ p_C; never use inference completion pose
pose_semantics.global_frames: map -> odom -> base_footprint -> torso are estimator outputs, not fixed ground-truth URDF joints; odom continuous, map corrections may jump

timing_contract.interpretation: Readout time is not conversion time; maintain mapped capture clocks, epoch and interpolation gaps. Missing calibration/pose/clock makes metric coordinates unavailable.

exclusions: No RGB/ToF capture on target ROCK4D claimed
Simulator global pose/segmentation withheld from deployable actor observations
